_meta.purpose: Surface forms for anti_flexing.never_unprompted, which is populated for all 11 personas and read by nothing. check_persona_forbidden reaches 5 of these 90 topics (6%); this file is what the remaining 85 need.
_meta.case_rule: Case sensitivity is PER CHARACTER, not per term. An UPPERCASE character in the term must be uppercase in the reply; a LOWERCASE character matches either case. This keeps the discriminator that matters ('the Senate' does not match 'senate', 'the Shadow' does not match 'a shadow', 'The Prince' does not match 'the prince you work for') while letting a term match at the start of a sentence ('my master' matches 'My master broke my leg'; 'the Enchiridion' matches 'The Enchiridion begins...'). A per-TERM rule fails the second case for any mixed-case term beginning with an article, which is what the first validation pass caught.
_meta.boundary_rule: Every term is matched with (?<!\w) ... (?!\w). Not \b, because terms are multi-word and may end in non-word characters.
_meta.user_exemption: A term the USER's message already contains is EXEMPT for that sample, matched case-insensitively. Per eval_suite_spec.md Test 3: 'A reply that mentions a peer because the USER mentioned the peer is exempt.' This is what makes 'Athens' in a user's holiday not a Socrates flex.

coverage_values.full: the surface forms of this topic are enumerable and enumerated
coverage_values.partial: the set is unbounded by construction (epigrams, aphorisms, anecdotes); the list catches the most-recited and declares the rest invisible
coverage_values.framed: the bare term is ordinary language; only the naming/explaining frame is a hit

_meta.reporting: Scored as its own column, NEVER summed with check_persona_forbidden. The two overlap on a handful of phrases (Bollingen, Meditations, 'Epictetus said', 'wu wei means'); summing would break comparability with the 1.09% production dry-run figure, which is the only calibration either scorer has.
_meta.permitted_by_prompt: A line the PROMPT seeds is not a flex. machiavelli_09 carries the only current instance: feared/loved is instructed by sentence_structure and system_fragment, so no variant of it appears in that term list (founder ruling, 2026-09-22 — no future re-adding). Any future term added here must be checked against the persona's own prompt text first: scoring a persona for obeying its instructions measures the list, not the persona.
_meta.not_covered: A persona flexing without a proper noun: Socrates performing his method unnamed, Wilde reciting an epigram not listed, Marcus lecturing Stoic doctrine without the word 'Stoic'. That residue is Test 4's LLM judge, not this file.

niccolo_machiavelli.note: FEARED/LOVED IS PERMITTED AND MUST NOT BE RE-ADDED (founder ruling, 2026-09-22). Every variant was removed from this list because the PROMPT ITSELF seeds the line as his register: sentence_structure says "Occasional aphorism that lands flat — it is safer to be feared than loved", and system_fragment repeats it in the BEHAVIOUR block. Scoring as a flex what the prompt instructs would measure the term list against the prompt, not the persona against the user.
niccolo_machiavelli.overlap_note: "the ends justify" is double-covered: forbidden_lexicon_persona_specific carries the regex  the ends? justif(y|ies) the means  and anchor_realist_not_cynic forbids it by name.
